title: Amazon S3 to Amazon OpenSearch Serverless with OpenSearch Ingestion
description: Ingest JSON objects from Amazon S3 into Amazon OpenSearch Serverless using an Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion (OSIS) pipeline.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern indexes JSON Lines files from Amazon S3 into an Amazon OpenSearch Serverless collection with an Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline. The source bucket sends `s3:ObjectCreated` notifications to an Amazon SQS queue. The pipeline polls the queue, reads each new object, parses every line into a document with `parse_json`, and writes it to the `s3-logs` index. Documents that fail to index go to a separate dead-letter S3 bucket, so they don't trigger the pipeline again. The template needs no application code.

Cost: the pipeline bills for at least 1 Ingestion OCU per hour while it runs, so stop it with `aws osis stop-pipeline` when you're not using it. The collection is in a collection group with a minimum of 0 OCUs, so it scales to zero and stops billing for compute after 10 minutes with no requests. The network policy allows public access for the demo; use a VPC endpoint for production.
